lines.speaker: Farmer
lines.text: For decades, a pact was made. Feed the creature before the countdown ends, or else the creature kills you.

lines.speaker: Fisherman
lines.text: It isn't so easy to make the dishes. You need to fetch ingredients and deal with different characters.

lines.speaker: Dairy Farmer
lines.text: The villagers found a way to survive using magical ingredients.

lines.speaker: Insect Keeper
lines.text: Until one day... there are no royal chefs. Just you.

lines.speaker: Creature
lines.text: Every meal earns you more time.

lines.speaker: Creature
lines.text: Fail... and you become the next meal.
